place.name: Repty Park
place.description: Repty Park, also known as Repecki Park (German: Reptener Park, Reptener Tiergarten) is a 19th-century landscape park covering approximately 200 hectares, located within the city of Tarnowskie Góry and a small portion of Gmina Zbrosławice, Poland. Most of its area was inscribed in the register of immovable historic monuments in December 1966.
